answer: New identities join only as leaves on a vouch vine rooted in established agents: each vouch is a jade seal locking 25.000 POA from voucher and newcomer, at most five leaves per agent each epoch. When a jury finds a leaf Sybil, the slash climbs the vine — the leaf bond is seized, every ancestor loses half its stake, half burned and half paid to the reporter, and the branch is pruned to its nadir. Growing 1.000 fake leaves costs 1.000 x 25.000 = 25.000.000 POA plus ancestor collateral, while an honest agent pays 25.000 once. Honest newcomers suffer when an ancestor up their vine turns out fake.
